title: Eos SENOLYTIX’s PTC-2105 Reduced Semaglutide-Associated Lean-Mass Loss in Aged Mice: Data to Be Presented at 19th Sarcopenia, Cachexia & Wasting Disorders International Conference

Eos SENOLYTIX Presents Late-Life Survival and Healthspan Data for Mitochondria-Targeted Geropeptide PTC-2105 at the 17th World Congress on Targeting Mitochondria, and Launches “Team Speedy” to Let the Public Follow Its Longest-Lived Mouse
